description: List or filter open maintenance alerts for a specific property or across the whole portfolio. Supports severity filtering and active-only (unresolved) filtering. IoT-sourced today; future Phase will merge Guesty-native task alerts.

listingId.description: Filter alerts to a specific listing ID. Omit for portfolio-wide.

severity.description: Filter by alert severity level (default: all)

name: get_maintenance_alerts
